title: 11 Best AI Employee Experience Platforms for Tech Firms in 2026
summary: Compare the 11 best AI employee experience platforms for tech firms in 2026, with features for engagement, people analytics, and workforce insights.
body_markdown:
AI


[employee experience](https://www.infeedo.ai/employee-experience-guide)


platforms drive serious business results.


Companies that outperform their competitors in employee experience are 2X more likely to achieve high customer satisfaction and retention.


Then they also report over 20% year-over-year revenue growth compared to underperforming organizations.


The right employee experience software matters more for mid-sized tech firms managing distributed engineering teams.


Employees in structured development programs are 50% more likely to stay with their employer. These platforms are critical to retain talent.


We've compared 11 employee engagement tools based on multi-channel support, automation capabilities and analytics depth. This will help you make a decision.


## [inFeedo AI (Amber)](https://www.infeedo.ai/)


Image Source:


[inFeedo AI](https://www.infeedo.ai/)


### What is inFeedo AI


inFeedo AI positions Amber as an AI Chief Engagement Officer rather than another survey platform. Amber holds conversations with employees at career-defining moments: first month onboarding, project changes, manager transitions, post-promotion periods and pre-exit phases. The platform converts these interactions into ranked


[attrition risk scores](https://www.infeedo.ai/blog/attrition-forecasting-employee-disengagement-signs)


with specific manager actions.


Built on 9 years of People Science research and 80M+ employee responses, Amber targets the silent employee population that conventional engagement tools miss.


Silent employees are 3X more likely to quit than survey respondents. This makes the capability critical for retention.


### Key Features for Tech Firms


The PTM (People-To-Meet) algorithm analyzes sentiment patterns, behavioral changes and silence indicators.


It ranks employees by attrition risk 60 to 90 days before exit. This prediction window allows time for career conversations, scope adjustments or compensation corrections that can change outcomes.


Conversational AI triggers natural-language check-ins based on lifecycle events rather than calendar quarters. Amber tracks employee trajectory by connecting responses over time.


The system catches gradual decline that point-in-time surveys average away.


The platform has 26 psychologist-designed templates grounded in a validated framework of 7 drivers and 45 elements.


Report Studio delivers decision-ready analytics with AI summaries and 50+ filters. The system identifies specific problem areas.


To cite an instance, it can find a 12-person platform team at 35% engagement inside a company-wide score of 80%.


Anonymous Ally provides a separate confidential channel for concerns employees won't attach their name to.


Manager action plans have auto-summarized conversations, role-specific recommended actions and AI-generated acknowledgment emails that close the feedback loop.


### Best for Distributed Engineering Teams


Amber automates


[98% of routine HR queries](https://www.infeedo.ai/)


and eliminates wait times for engineers in time zones of all types.


The platform supports delivery via Slack, Microsoft Teams, WhatsApp, email, SMS and web. Engineers get messages in channels they already use.


Response rates remain high in engineering populations that ignore email survey links.


The system triggers check-ins after engineering-specific events: a developer's third consecutive sprint with scope changes or a team's second on-call incident within a week. Lens analytics unifies people data and sentiment mapping.


This supports strategic decision-making for engineering leaders.


### Pricing


inFeedo quotes pricing per employee based on headcount and selected modules.


Three module options exist: Listening (continuous feedback and predictive insights), Automation (service delivery and workflow automation) and Communication (targeted campaigns and personalized messaging). Detailed pricing requires contacting their sales team through the official pricing page.


### Integration Capabilities


inFeedo connects with Slack, Microsoft Teams, WhatsApp, Gmail, Google Chat, Line and SMS for messaging delivery.


[HRMS integrations](https://www.infeedo.ai/integrations)


have Workday, SAP, Oracle, PeopleSoft, Darwinbox, PeopleStrong and Workplace.


The platform also integrates with Google Sheets, Data Studio for analytics and Glassdoor for employer branding.


API and SFTP options enable custom integrations, with multi-language support across 34 languages.


## [Culture Amp](https://www.cultureamp.com/)


Image Source:


[Culture Amp](https://www.cultureamp.com/)


### What is Culture Amp


Culture Amp operates as a survey-first


[employee experience platform](https://www.infeedo.ai/glossary/employee-experience-platform)


grounded in organizational psychology and data science.


The company serves 6,000+ customers and has launched over 70.5 million surveys that collected 13 million total responses.


Culture Amp maintains the largest source of engagement and performance data globally, built on more than 1.6 billion questions answered.


The platform earned recognition on the Constellation ShortList for Talent Management Suites in 2026. The company structures around a culture-first philosophy and provides HR teams with measuring data, 40+ science-backed survey templates, and action planning tools.


### Key Features for Tech Firms


The Performance Culture Quadrant connects employee engagement metrics with performance data and creates a unified view of organizational health.


AI Coach provides three distinct functions: it surfaces focus areas from engagement survey data, guides managers through complex conversations with expert coaching and role play, and accelerates performance review creation. This AI functionality handles post-survey analysis and manager support. inFeedo AI's Amber takes a different approach by holding continuous conversations at career-defining moments and catches issues 60 to 90 days before exit rather than waiting for quarterly survey cycles.


Culture Amp delivers 40+ ready-to-use survey templates that have DEI surveys, pulse surveys, and onboarding/offboarding assessments with AI comment summaries.


The platform has goal tracking that arranges individual and team objectives with organizational strategy, 360-degree reviews with peer and manager feedback, continuous feedback mechanisms, and performance calibration tools.


Auto-generated PowerPoint presentations save considerable time and enable administrators to create location-specific reports for global teams in under an hour.


### Best for Distributed Engineering Teams


Culture Amp employs over 200 engineers who work in cross-functional Agile teams across 30-60 person groups called Camps.


The workforce spans Melbourne (223 employees), San Francisco (89), New York (58), Chicago (42), and London (39). 325 employees work remotely. This distributed structure reflects their remote-friendly approach, though the platform itself relies on email-based survey delivery. Engineering teams that ignore email survey links or work asynchronously across time zones face challenges. inFeedo delivers check-ins through Slack, Microsoft Teams, WhatsApp, and SMS where engineers already spend their time and maintains higher response rates in technical populations.


### Pricing


Culture Amp follows a per-employee-per-month model with costs ranging from ₹759.42 to ₹1,181.33 PEPM for simple plans.


Enterprise level pricing reaches


[₹9,956.89-₹10,294.41 per user](https://elearningindustry.com/culture-amps-pricing-plans-and-costs-which-plan-is-right-for-you) .


Annual subscription costs span ₹843,804.51 to ₹3,797,120.29 depending on company size.


Organizations with 200 employees report paying approximately ₹2,278,272.17 annually, while 1,000-employee companies approach ₹3,797,120.29. Pricing depends on employee count, selected products (Engage, Perform, or Grow plans), and service tier.


All products are billed annually.


The pricing model favors larger organizations and becomes expensive for companies under 75 employees relatively.


### Integration Capabilities


Culture Amp automatically syncs with


[HRIS platforms](https://www.infeedo.ai/blog/hris-integration-meets-itsm-agentic-ai-employee-workflows)


that have Workday, BambooHR, Dayforce, Paylocity, HiBob, Personio, Namely, and Gusto.


The platform offers API access to create custom dashboards and bespoke reporting.


Integration extends to compensation systems and helps leaders connect performance to pay decisions.


Collaboration tool integrations have Slack and Microsoft Teams for feedback sharing.


The platform connects with LifeLabs Learning and Go1 for educational resources.


SFTP and SAML SSO options provide additional data exchange and authentication methods.


## [Lattice](https://lattice.com/)


Image Source:


[Lattice](https://lattice.com/)


### What is Lattice


Lattice unites


[performance management](https://www.infeedo.ai/performance-management-guide) , employee engagement and AI tools into a unified people platform.


The company serves over 5,000 customers including Reddit, Asana and Slack. The system connects performance reviews, goal setting, feedback workflows and engagement surveys in one location.


You don't need separate point solutions. Sarah Franklin joined as CEO in January 2024.


She plans to expand AI capabilities across employee management functions.


It's worth mentioning that Lattice discontinued its HRIS and payroll products following a Workday partnership, with


[HRIS access ending July 31, 2026](https://www.hrmsworld.com/lattice-software-profile.html) .


### Key Features for Tech Firms


Lattice AI Agent functions beyond standard chatbots.


It answers HR policy questions, provides career path guidance and coaches managers during 1:1s without requiring document searches.


The platform runs flexible review cycles (annual, quarterly or project-based) with self, peer and manager reviews compiled into organized review packets.


Performance management tools include continuous feedback mechanisms and live praise shared through Slack and Microsoft Teams.


You also get structured 1:1 meeting templates and weekly updates that track progress.


Goals and OKRs ladder from individual to department level.


They connect daily work to business outcomes with progress tracking.


Engagement surveys employ


[AI-powered insights](https://www.infeedo.ai/predictive-people-analytics)


to analyze sentiment patterns, coupled with pulse checks and eNPS measurements.


The compensation module links performance data to salary benchmarking, pay bands and structured review cycles.


Career development features include competency matrices, growth plans and transparent progression paths.


### Best for Distributed Engineering Teams


Lattice supports remote workflows through Slack, Teams and Zoom integrations.


You can handle reviews, feedback and check-ins.


The mobile app (iOS and Android) enables on-the-go feedback, review submission, 1:1 management and goal tracking from any location. But while Lattice integrates with collaboration tools, inFeedo AI delivers check-ins directly through Slack, Microsoft Teams, WhatsApp, email and SMS where engineers already work. Response rates remain higher when platforms meet engineers in their native channels. Redirecting them to separate survey systems doesn't work as well, making inFeedo's multi-channel approach more effective for distributed technical teams.


### Pricing


Lattice follows modular, per-user annual billing starting at


[₹928.18 monthly](https://lattice.com/pricing) :


Module Monthly Cost Core Features


Talent Management ₹928.18 Performance reviews, Goals/OKRs, 1:1s, Feedback, Core AI


Engagement +₹337.52 Surveys, Pulse, eNPS, AI insights


Grow +₹337.52 Career tracks, Competencies, Growth plans


Compensation +₹506.28 Benchmarking, Cycle management, Pay bands


A ₹337,521.80 minimum annual agreement applies.


### Integration Capabilities


Lattice connects with HRIS platforms including Workday, BambooHR, ADP, Gusto, UKG and Greenhouse.


Productivity integrations span Slack, Microsoft Teams, Google Suite, Jira and Asana.


The platform supports SSO authentication and API access for custom workflows.


## [Microsoft Viva Glint](https://www.microsoft.com/en-in/microsoft-viva/glint)


Image Source:


[Microsoft](https://www.microsoft.com/)


### What is Microsoft Viva Glint


Microsoft acquired Glint from LinkedIn in 2022 and integrated it into the Viva suite as a people-driven platform that provides visibility into organizational health.


The platform delivers customizable surveys focused on engagement, onboarding, exit, diversity and inclusion, digital transformation, change management, 360-degree feedback and other critical moments.


Microsoft reported 10 million paid users across 1,000 customers within one year of Viva's launch.


Viva Glint creates a people-science based measurement strategy to assess


[employee engagement](https://www.infeedo.ai/employee-engagement)


and translate insights into action. But the platform requires deep Microsoft ecosystem integration, which limits flexibility for tech firms running multi-vendor tool stacks.


### Key Features for Tech Firms


Viva Glint employs AI through Microsoft 365 Copilot to process large volumes of employee survey comments.


The system summarizes thousands of responses in seconds to identify key themes and sentiments. The AI analyzes comments based on demographic filters such as department, tenure or location.


Organizations can pinpoint specific areas of concern within different employee groups.


Users interact with Copilot through natural language prompts to generate summaries or explore specific topics within feedback data.


The platform's integration with


[Viva Insights](https://www.infeedo.ai/blog/ai-in-employee-retention-detecting-team-health-issues-before-they-lead-to-exitsai-employee-retention-team-health-monitoring)


combines survey sentiment data with behavioral metrics.


These include manager 1:1 time, after-hours work patterns, collaboration hours and network size.


Analyzing the relationship between manager 1:1 time and feelings of empowerment provides applicable information for leadership to boost team dynamics.


This integration strengthens HR professionals to develop targeted strategies that address specific engagement drivers.


Results appear after survey closure through heatmaps, results visualization and trend analysis.


### Best for Distributed Engineering Teams


Viva Glint brings survey notifications into Microsoft Teams through invite reminders and results notifications. Users need individual Teams licenses to receive Viva Glint notifications.


Admins must enable Teams as a communication channel before survey launches.


The platform requires minimum 50 seats and ensures employee records match between Viva Glint and Viva Insights by adding Glint user emails to Entra ID.


Viva Glint supports remote workflows through Teams integration, but inFeedo AI meets distributed engineering teams across Slack, Microsoft Teams, WhatsApp, email and SMS channels where engineers already work. Response rates remain higher when platforms deliver check-ins through native engineering channels rather than requiring Microsoft ecosystem adoption. inFeedo's PTM algorithm identifies attrition risk 60 to 90 days before exit through continuous conversations at career-defining moments. It catches issues that quarterly survey cycles miss.


### Pricing


Viva Glint costs


[₹165 per user per month](https://www.microsoft.com/en-in/microsoft-viva/glint)


when paid yearly. Microsoft bundles Viva Glint with other tools: Viva Workplace Analytics and Employee Feedback at ₹500 per user per month has Glint plus Viva Insights and Viva Pulse.


The full Viva Suite reaches ₹1,000 per user per month.


### Integration Capabilities


Viva Glint integrates naturally with Microsoft Teams, SharePoint and other Microsoft Viva suite tools.


The platform connects with Viva Insights to combine sentiment and collaboration data through Power BI reporting templates.


Integration requires Entra ID synchronization and confidentiality threshold compliance.


All Glint user email domains must be added to the tenant's MAC domain list.


## [Qualtrics Employee Experience](https://www.qualtrics.com/en-au/)


Image Source:


[Qualtrics](https://www.qualtrics.com/)


### What is Qualtrics XM


Qualtrics XM Platform started in 2002 and evolved from experience management research into employee lifecycle software serving organizations worldwide. The platform captures workforce signals and converts them into tailored manager insights with recommended actions.


Executives receive workforce intelligence demonstrating initiative ROI.


The system measures engagement, inclusion and wellbeing through over 300 survey items. AI analytics process feedback for analytical decisions.


State of Iowa's centralized


[employee experience](https://www.infeedo.ai/employee-experience)


program using Qualtrics created useful feedback loops that increased engagement and productivity.


### Key Features for Tech Firms


Digital Listening Posts enable anonymous employee feedback submissions beyond annual surveys and create an always-on feedback structure. Frontline employees can offer immediate suggestions on customer interactions.


All data compiles in centralized dashboards featuring ratings over time and comment analysis.


Prescriptive Insights powered by Qualtrics iQ surfaces engagement opportunities for each manager and compares team scores against company averages.


Guided action planning pairs with these insights and surfaces recommended tasks, resources and best practices.


[Employee Pulse](https://www.infeedo.ai/pulse-surveys)


delivers immediate insights through automated feedback. 360 Development Feedback supports growth with expert frameworks.


Benefits Optimizer analyzes trade-offs in compensation packages and allows leaders to gather data on employee priorities.


Employer Brand Tracking integrates responses from Glassdoor and Indeed into dashboards and combines external and internal listening systems.


The platform has survey design, response management, reporting and collaboration in one location.


### Best for Distributed Engineering Teams


Qualtrics sends tailored surveys through Microsoft Teams with recurring message schedules and action plan reminders.


Users need the Qualtrics app installed with specific Teams permissions that include offline_access, Team.ReadBasic.All and TeamsActivity.Send.


The connection expires after 90 days without distributions.


Qualtrics supports Teams integration, but inFeedo AI delivers check-ins across Slack, Microsoft Teams, WhatsApp, email and SMS where engineers already work. Qualtrics requires manual survey distribution setup. inFeedo automates 98% of routine HR queries and eliminates wait times across time zones. The platform's reliance on survey-based engagement misses the silent employee population that inFeedo's PTM algorithm identifies 60 to 90 days before exit through continuous conversations at career-defining moments.


### Pricing


Qualtrics XM for Employee Experience starts at


[INR 421,902.25 annually](https://www.capterra.in/software/140443/qualtrics-employee-engagement) .


The pricing model bases costs on employee count


and maintains this structure.


Newer customer experience and strategy products shifted to interaction-based pricing.


### Integration Capabilities


Qualtrics offers API integration for custom extensions and automated data exchange.


Microsoft Teams integration requires brand administrator setup.


The platform connects with Salesforce and Microsoft Dynamics.


Extensions are paid upgrades not included in standard licenses.


Qualtrics refers to third-party consulting firms for advanced customer support rather than providing full in-house service.
